summary: The Transport Desk acknowledges a transport complaint within 4 hours of receipt.
A complaint is escalated to the Transport Operations Lead when it remains unresolved after 2 working days.
Scheduled transport is suspended when the competent local authority issues an orange or red weather alert affecting the operating area.
Transport service resumes only after the relevant alert has been withdrawn or the affected access route has been confirmed operationally suitable.
Sunday operations require a separate written sanction from the Director HR, including when a Saturday arrangement has already been approved.
